title: datura wallichii
intro: Datura wallichii, commonly known as Devil's Trumpet or Angels Trumpet, is a plant species within the nightshade family, characterized by its unique trumpet-shaped flowers. The plant has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including the ability to lower blood pressure and reduce inflammation. The therapeutic actions of Datura wallichii include its sedative, anti-anxiety, and antispasmodic properties, making it a potential natural remedy for insomnia and muscle relaxation. The bioactive constituents of Datura wallichii include alkaloids such as scopolamine and hyoscyamine, which contribute to its therapeutic effects.
